records.context: A spaCR project is a folder of derived data.  ``merged/`` came from raw images, ``measurements.db`` came from ``merged/``, the model came from the extracted image regions the database indexes, and the hit list came from the model.  The files themselves do not record these links, so without a registry a result cannot be checked against its inputs: after Mask is executed again with a different diameter, every downstream number is out of date and nothing marks it.
records.label: spacr.artifacts#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A spaCR project is a folder of derived data.  ``merged/`` came from raw images, ``measurements.db`` came from ``merged/``, the model came from the crops the database indexes, and the hit list came from the model.  The files themselves do not record these links, so without a registry a result cannot be checked against its inputs: after Mask is re-run with a different diameter, every downstream number is out of date and nothing marks it.
records.translation: spaCR 项目是一个存放派生数据的文件夹。``merged/`` 来自原始图像，``measurements.db`` 来自 ``merged/``，模型来自数据库所索引的裁剪图像，命中列表则来自模型。文件本身并不记录这些关联，因此没有注册表时，就无法将某个结果与其输入进行核对：用不同的直径重新运行 Mask 之后，下游的每个数字都已过时，却没有任何标记说明这一点。

records.context: ``Registry`` The registry for one project: :meth:`~Registry.register`, :meth:`~Registry.get`, :meth:`~Registry.by_kind`, :meth:`~Registry.by_project`, :meth:`~Registry.latest`, :meth:`~Registry.downstream_of`, :meth:`~Registry.upstream_of`, :meth:`~Registry.is_stale`, :meth:`~Registry.forget`. ``open_registry``, and module-level ``register`` / ``by_kind`` / ``by_project`` / ``latest`` / ``downstream_of`` / ``is_stale`` The same, resolved from a project path. ``register_run_outputs`` The one call a finished processing session makes; walks :func:`spacr.ports.declared_outputs` and registers what is there. ``Artifact``, ``Staleness``, ``Fingerprint`` The records that come back. ``settings_hash``, ``material_settings``, ``content_fingerprint`` The provenance primitives, usable on their own.
records.label: spacr.artifacts#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``Registry`` The registry for one project: :meth:`~Registry.register`, :meth:`~Registry.get`, :meth:`~Registry.by_kind`, :meth:`~Registry.by_project`, :meth:`~Registry.latest`, :meth:`~Registry.downstream_of`, :meth:`~Registry.upstream_of`, :meth:`~Registry.is_stale`, :meth:`~Registry.forget`. ``open_registry``, and module-level ``register`` / ``by_kind`` / ``by_project`` / ``latest`` / ``downstream_of`` / ``is_stale`` The same, resolved from a project path. ``register_run_outputs`` The one call a finished run makes; walks :func:`spacr.ports.declared_outputs` and registers what is there. ``Artifact``, ``Staleness``, ``Fingerprint`` The records that come back. ``settings_hash``, ``material_settings``, ``content_fingerprint`` The provenance primitives, usable on their own.
records.translation: ``Registry`` 单个项目的注册表：:meth:`~Registry.register`、:meth:`~Registry.get`、:meth:`~Registry.by_kind`、:meth:`~Registry.by_project`、:meth:`~Registry.latest`、:meth:`~Registry.downstream_of`、:meth:`~Registry.upstream_of`、:meth:`~Registry.is_stale`、:meth:`~Registry.forget`。``open_registry``，以及模块级的 ``register`` / ``by_kind`` / ``by_project`` / ``latest`` / ``downstream_of`` / ``is_stale`` 功能相同，但根据项目路径解析注册表。``register_run_outputs`` 已完成的运行所进行的唯一一次调用；遍历 :func:`spacr.ports.declared_outputs` 并注册实际存在的内容。``Artifact``、``Staleness``、``Fingerprint`` 返回的记录。``settings_hash``、``material_settings``、``content_fingerprint`` 来源信息的基本组件，可单独使用。

records.context: Storage is SQLite — ``artifacts.db`` in the project root, one row per artifact plus one edge row per input — because two Measure workers, a GUI and a batch runner can all be touching a project at once, and a pickle cannot survive that.  Writes go through :func:`spacr.database_concurrency.transaction` with an explicit lock budget, which is also why nothing here does its own retry arithmetic.
records.label: spacr.artifacts#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Storage is SQLite — ``artifacts.db`` in the project root, one row per artifact plus one edge row per input — because two Measure workers, a GUI and a batch runner can all be touching a project at once, and a pickle cannot survive that.  Writes go through :func:`spacr.database_concurrency.transaction` with an explicit lock budget, which is also why nothing here does its own retry arithmetic.
records.translation: 存储采用 SQLite——项目根目录中的 ``artifacts.db``，每个产物一行，每个输入另有一条边记录——因为两个 Measure 工作进程、一个 GUI 和一个批处理运行器可能同时访问同一个项目，而 pickle 无法应对这种情况。写入通过带有显式锁预算的 :func:`spacr.database_concurrency.transaction` 进行，这也是此处没有任何代码自行进行重试计算的原因。

records.context: A regular file is hashed end to end while it is small enough to be worth it, and above ``full_hash_limit`` from its size plus its first and last megabyte — enough to notice a rewritten database without spending minutes of I/O at the end of every processing session. Symlinks are skipped — linked files are ignored and linked subfolders are not descended into — so a folder of links fingerprints as empty.
records.label: spacr.artifacts.content_fingerprint#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A regular file is hashed end to end while it is small enough to be worth it, and above ``full_hash_limit`` from its size plus its first and last megabyte — enough to notice a rewritten database without spending minutes of I/O at the end of every run. A folder is fingerprinted from its file inventory: each file's relative path, size and modification time, in sorted order. Symlinks are skipped — linked files are ignored and linked subfolders are not descended into — so a folder of links fingerprints as empty.
records.translation: 普通文件在足够小、值得完整计算时会被完整计算哈希；超过 ``full_hash_limit`` 时，则根据其大小加上开头和末尾各一兆字节计算——这足以发现被重写的数据库，而无需在每次运行结束时花费数分钟的 I/O。文件夹根据其文件清单计算指纹：每个文件的相对路径、大小和修改时间，按排序顺序排列。符号链接会被跳过——链接的文件被忽略，链接的子文件夹不会被深入遍历——因此只包含链接的文件夹的指纹为空。

records.context: Concurrency: jobs run **strictly one at a time**. They compete for one GPU, and two Cellpose jobs on one card can execute out of CUDA memory. There is no ``max_workers`` option; to use two cards, run two software job lists in two processes.

records.source: Concurrency: jobs run **strictly one at a time**. They compete for one GPU, and two Cellpose jobs on one card can run out of CUDA memory. There is no ``max_workers`` option; to use two cards, run two queues in two processes.
records.translation: 并发：作业**严格逐个**运行。它们争用同一块 GPU，而同一张显卡上的两个 Cellpose 作业可能会耗尽 CUDA 内存。没有 ``max_workers`` 选项；要使用两张显卡，请在两个进程中运行两个队列。

records.source: This module is the other axis. It holds a queue of arbitrary ``(module, settings)`` jobs in any order: ``Mask → Measure → Classify (CV) → Classify (ML)``, then the same four again with a different diameter, then a fifth plate's Mask.
records.translation: 本模块对应另一个维度。它保存一个由任意 ``(module, settings)`` 作业组成、顺序不限的队列：``Mask → Measure → Classify (CV) → Classify (ML)``，然后以不同的直径再运行同样的四个作业，接着再运行第五块板的 Mask。

records.context: **Every job is validated when it is added, not when it executes.** :func:`validate_queue` reports *all* problems at once and :func:`run_queue` refuses to start while any of them is an error.
records.label: spacr.batch#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Every job is validated when it is added, not when it runs.** :func:`validate_queue` reports *all* problems at once and :func:`run_queue` refuses to start while any of them is an error.
records.translation: **每个作业在添加时而不是运行时进行验证。**:func:`validate_queue` 会一次性报告*所有*问题，只要其中有任何错误，:func:`run_queue` 就会拒绝启动。

records.context: **State is persisted after every transition, atomically.** A machine that reboots while processing the software job list is resumed with :func:`resume_queue`, not restarted. The file is written to a temp name and ``os.replace``\ d, so a crash cannot leave a truncated work list file.
records.label: spacr.batch#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **State is persisted after every transition, atomically.** A machine that reboots mid-queue is resumed with :func:`resume_queue`, not restarted. The file is written to a temp name and ``os.replace``\ d, so a crash cannot leave a truncated queue file.
records.translation: **每次状态转换后都会以原子方式持久化状态。**在队列中途重启的机器会通过 :func:`resume_queue` 恢复，而不是从头开始。文件先写入临时名称，再通过 ``os.replace`` 替换到位，因此崩溃不会留下被截断的队列文件。

records.context: **A job whose dependency failed is skipped, not executed.** Measure after a failed Mask produces a database that looks like a real result. ``skipped`` (deliberately not executed), ``failed`` and ``not_run`` (the software job list halted before reaching it) are three different things and stay that way.
records.label: spacr.batch#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A job whose dependency failed is skipped, not run.** Measure after a failed Mask produces a database that looks like a real result. ``skipped`` (deliberately not run), ``failed`` and ``not_run`` (the queue halted before reaching it) are three different things and stay that way.
records.translation: **依赖失败的作业会被跳过，而不是运行。**在失败的 Mask 之后运行 Measure 会产生一个看起来像真实结果的数据库。``skipped``（有意不运行）、``failed`` 和 ``not_run``（队列在到达它之前已停止）是三种不同的情况，并且始终保持区分。

records.context: **Repeated failures halt the work list.** Under continue-on-error, ``max_consecutive_failures`` (3 by default) halts the work list after that many failures in a row and records the reason.

records.source: **Repeated failures halt the queue.** Under continue-on-error, ``max_consecutive_failures`` (3 by default) halts the queue after that many failures in a row and records the reason.

Failed and skipped jobs stay as they are unless ``retry_failed`` is set.

records.source: Jobs that already succeeded are left alone. Jobs that were ``not_run`` (the queue halted before reaching them) or still ``pending`` are run. A job that was ``running`` when the machine went down is reset and run again. For Mask, Measure, and Format Converter jobs the rerun receives ``resume=True`` automatically, so their verified field checkpoints are reused instead of repeating the whole plate. Failed and skipped jobs stay as they are unless ``retry_failed`` is set.
records.translation: 已经成功的作业保持不变。``not_run``（队列在到达它们之前已停止）或仍为 ``pending`` 的作业会被运行。机器宕机时处于 ``running`` 状态的作业会被重置并再次运行。对于 Mask、Measure 和 Format Converter 作业，重新运行时会自动获得 ``resume=True``，因此会复用其已验证的视野检查点，而不是重复处理整块板。失败和被跳过的作业保持原样，除非设置了 ``retry_failed``。

records.context: The outer ring of a microtitre laboratory microplate evaporates faster, sits at a different temperature and is handled differently from the interior. A microplate sample position in row A or column 24 that reads three sigma from the laboratory microplate mean is therefore much more likely to be an artefact of *where it sits* than of what is in it.

records.translation: 微孔板的外圈蒸发更快、温度不同，操作方式也与内部不同。因此，第 A 行或第 24 列中一个与板均值相差三个 sigma 的孔，更有可能是*其所在位置*造成的假象，而不是其中内容所致。

A screen that only used rows A-H of a 384 laboratory microplate does not get row H promoted to "edge" just because nothing was pipetted below it.

records.translation: **板格式是推断出来的，绝不是假定的。**6/12/24/48/96/384/1536 会根据观测到的行和列标签加以识别，圈层几何采用所推断格式的*标称*网格。一个只使用了 384 板 A-H 行的筛选，不会仅仅因为其下方没有加样就把 H 行提升为 "edge"。

records.context: Statistical choices
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Statistical choices
records.translation: 统计方法的选择

records.context: **Rank tests, not t-tests.** Per-microplate sample position aggregates of object measurements are routinely skewed and heavy-tailed — a microplate sample position with three enormous cells is not a normal deviate. The ring comparison is a two-sided Mann-Whitney U; the gradient test is Spearman. Neither assumes a shape.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Rank tests, not t-tests.** Per-well aggregates of object measurements are routinely skewed and heavy-tailed — a well with three enormous cells is not a normal deviate. The ring comparison is a two-sided Mann-Whitney U; the gradient test is Spearman. Neither assumes a shape.
records.translation: **采用秩检验，而不是 t 检验。**对象测量值的逐孔汇总通常是偏斜且重尾的——一个只有三个巨大细胞的孔并不是正态离差。圈层比较采用双侧 Mann-Whitney U 检验；梯度检验采用 Spearman 检验。两者都不对分布形状作假设。

records.context: **Effect size leads, p-value follows.** With 384 microplate sample positions, almost any systematic drift clears p < 0.05; that fact carries no information. Every comparison therefore reports the median difference, the difference as a percentage of the interior median, *and* Cliff's delta — a rank-based standardised effect in [-1, 1] read straight off the same U statistic (``δ = 2U/n₁n₂ − 1``). Detection requires both a small p **and** an effect size above :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_EFFECT`, so a significant but 0.4 % difference is not reported as an edge effect.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Effect size leads, p-value follows.** With 384 wells, almost any systematic drift clears p < 0.05; that fact carries no information. Every comparison therefore reports the median difference, the difference as a percentage of the interior median, *and* Cliff's delta — a rank-based standardised effect in [-1, 1] read straight off the same U statistic (``δ = 2U/n₁n₂ − 1``). Detection requires both a small p **and** an effect size above :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_EFFECT`, so a significant but 0.4 % difference is not reported as an edge effect.
records.translation: **效应量为主，p 值为辅。**有 384 个孔时，几乎任何系统性漂移都能达到 p < 0.05；这一事实本身不携带任何信息。因此，每次比较都会报告中位数差值、该差值占内部中位数的百分比，*以及* Cliff's delta——一个取值在 [-1, 1] 内、直接由同一 U 统计量得出的基于秩的标准化效应（``δ = 2U/n₁n₂ − 1``）。检测需要同时满足较小的 p **和**超过 :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_EFFECT` 的效应量，因此显著但只有 0.4 % 的差异不会被报告为边缘效应。

records.context: **Evaporation is not a step function.** The profile walks inward ring by ring (outermost = ring 0), comparing each against the laboratory microplate core, so a gradient that reaches two microplate sample positions in is visible instead of being averaged into "the interior".
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Evaporation is not a step function.** The profile walks inward ring by ring (outermost = ring 0), comparing each against the plate core, so a gradient that reaches two wells in is visible instead of being averaged into "the interior".
records.translation: **蒸发不是阶跃函数。**剖面逐圈向内推进（最外圈为 ring 0），将每一圈与板的核心区域进行比较，因此深入两个孔的梯度也能显现出来，而不会被平均到 "the interior" 之中。

records.context: **A gradient is not an edge effect.** An incubator or laboratory microplate-reader gradient runs *across* the laboratory microplate; evaporation runs *around* it. A linear column gradient leaves the outer ring with the same median as the interior (it collects both the high and the low end), so the ring test stays quiet while Spearman on the column index fires. Both are computed, both are reported, and :attr:`EdgeEffectReport.dominant` names which one better explains the laboratory microplate.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A gradient is not an edge effect.** An incubator or plate-reader gradient runs *across* the plate; evaporation runs *around* it. A linear column gradient leaves the outer ring with the same median as the interior (it collects both the high and the low end), so the ring test stays quiet while Spearman on the column index fires. Both are computed, both are reported, and :attr:`EdgeEffectReport.dominant` names which one better explains the plate.
records.translation: **梯度不是边缘效应。**培养箱或酶标仪的梯度*横跨*整块板；蒸发则*环绕*整块板。线性的列梯度会使外圈的中位数与内部相同（外圈同时包含高端和低端），因此圈层检验保持沉默，而针对列索引的 Spearman 检验会触发。两者都会计算和报告，并由 :attr:`EdgeEffectReport.dominant` 指明哪一种更能解释该板。

records.context: The outer ring is compared against everything inside it with a two-sided Mann-Whitney U — rank-based, because per-microplate sample position aggregates of object measurements are skewed often enough that a t-test would be testing its own assumptions rather than the laboratory microplate. records.label: spacr.plate_qc.detect_edge_effect#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The outer ring is compared against everything inside it with a two-sided Mann-Whitney U — rank-based, because per-well aggregates of object measurements are skewed often enough that a t-test would be testing its own assumptions rather than the plate. The accompanying Cliff's delta comes off the same U statistic, so effect size and p-value cannot disagree about which comparison was made.
records.translation: 外圈与其内部的所有孔通过双侧 Mann-Whitney U 检验进行比较——采用基于秩的方法，因为对象测量值的逐孔汇总常常是偏斜的，t 检验检验的将是它自己的假设，而不是这块板。随附的 Cliff's delta 由同一 U 统计量得出，因此效应量和 p 值不可能在所做的是哪一种比较上产生分歧。

records.context: **Existing rows are removed prior to inserting replacements.** The measurement workflow calls ``to_sql(if_exists='append')`` to append rows. Measuring a field again would create a duplicate of each object rather than replace the old rows. This makes ``count_cell`` twice as large and biases the mean for each well. Removing old rows prior to another measurement makes the operation safe to repeat.
records.label: spacr.resume.clear_field_rows#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **This is the delete-before-insert.** Measure appends (``to_sql(if_exists='append')``), so re-running a field that already wrote rows adds a second copy of every object rather than replacing the first. Downstream, ``count_cell`` doubles, per-well means are computed over the doubled population, and nothing in the artifact says so. Calling this immediately before re-measuring a field is what makes a resume idempotent.
records.translation: **这就是先删除后插入的操作。**Measure 以追加方式写入（``to_sql(if_exists='append')``），因此重新运行一个已写入行的视野会为每个对象添加第二份副本，而不是替换第一份。在下游，``count_cell`` 会翻倍，逐孔均值会基于翻倍后的群体计算，而产物中没有任何内容说明这一点。在重新测量某个视野之前立即调用本函数，正是使恢复具有幂等性的关键。

records.source: Three safety properties, all tested:
records.translation: 三项安全属性，均经过测试：

records.context: **All or nothing.** Every table is deleted from inside one ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` … ``COMMIT``. If any statement fails — a missing table, a trigger, a lock — the transaction is rolled back and the database is left exactly as it was. A half-cleared field would be worse than an uncleared one.
records.label: spacr.resume.clear_field_rows#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **All or nothing.** Every table is deleted from inside one ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` … ``COMMIT``. If any statement fails — a missing table, a trigger, a lock — the transaction is rolled back and the database is left exactly as it was. A half-cleared field would be worse than an uncleared one.
records.translation: **全有或全无。**所有表都在同一个 ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` … ``COMMIT`` 内部删除。如果任何语句失败——缺少表、触发器、锁——事务都会回滚，数据库保持原样。清除了一半的视野比未清除的视野更糟糕。

records.context: **Keyed on the field, not on its name.** The WHERE clause is equality over ``plateID``/``rowID``/``columnID``/``fieldID``, so clearing ``f1`` cannot touch ``f10``–``f19`` the way a ``LIKE 'plate1_A01_f1%'`` would. A table missing any of the four raises rather than running a broader delete.
records.label: spacr.resume.clear_field_rows#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Keyed on the field, not on its name.** The WHERE clause is equality over ``plateID``/``rowID``/``columnID``/``fieldID``, so clearing ``f1`` cannot touch ``f10``–``f19`` the way a ``LIKE 'plate1_A01_f1%'`` would. A table missing any of the four raises rather than running a broader delete.
records.translation: **以视野而不是其名称为键。**WHERE 子句是对 ``plateID``/``rowID``/``columnID``/``fieldID`` 的相等比较，因此清除 ``f1`` 不会波及 ``f10``–``f19``，而 ``LIKE 'plate1_A01_f1%'`` 则会。缺少这四列中任何一列的表会引发异常，而不是执行范围更大的删除。

records.context: **Only measure's own tables.** Every table is checked against :data:`MEASURE_OWNED_TABLES` before anything is deleted, and one that is not on it aborts the whole call. ``measurements.db`` is shared — ``conversion_map``, ``align_coordinates`` and ``foreign_*`` live there and carry the same four identifier columns so that they join — and clearing a field out of those destroys the only record of how the project's files were named and registered.
records.label: spacr.resume.clear_field_rows#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Only measure's own tables.** Every table is checked against :data:`MEASURE_OWNED_TABLES` before anything is deleted, and one that is not on it aborts the whole call. ``measurements.db`` is shared — ``conversion_map``, ``align_coordinates`` and ``foreign_*`` live there and carry the same four key columns so that they join — and clearing a field out of those destroys the only record of how the project's files were named and registered.
records.translation: **只限 measure 自己的表。**在删除任何内容之前，每张表都会与 :data:`MEASURE_OWNED_TABLES` 进行核对，任何不在其中的表都会中止整个调用。``measurements.db`` 是共享的——``conversion_map``、``align_coordinates`` 和 ``foreign_*`` 都存放在其中，并带有相同的四个键列以便连接——而从这些表中清除某个视野，会破坏关于项目文件如何命名和配准的唯一记录。

records.context: **Only rows measure itself wrote.** Owned by name is not owned in fact: in a project built by ``foreign.run_import`` the rows in ``cell`` are the import's, sitting under spaCR's own metadata columns in a table that is on the allow-list. Every DELETE is therefore narrowed by :func:`measure_rows_clause`, which is true only for rows holding a value in a column the importer never wrote. Clearing a field takes measure's rows for that field and leaves the import's — in the same table, in the same statement.
records.label: spacr.resume.clear_field_rows#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Only rows measure itself wrote.** Owned by name is not owned in fact: in a project built by ``foreign.run_import`` the rows in ``cell`` are the import's, sitting under spaCR's own metadata columns in a table that is on the allow-list. Every DELETE is therefore narrowed by :func:`measure_rows_clause`, which is true only for rows holding a value in a column the importer never wrote. Clearing a field takes measure's rows for that field and leaves the import's — in the same table, in the same statement.
records.translation: **只限 measure 自己写入的行。**按名称归属并不等于实际归属：在由 ``foreign.run_import`` 构建的项目中，``cell`` 中的行属于导入，它们位于一张在允许列表上的表中、处于 spaCR 自己的元数据列之下。因此，每条 DELETE 语句都会通过 :func:`measure_rows_clause` 加以收窄，该条件只对在导入器从未写入的某一列中有值的行成立。清除某个视野会删除 measure 为该视野写入的行，而保留导入的行——在同一张表中、同一条语句里。

records.translation: 按行进行的归属检验，以片段形式通过 AND 并入 WHERE 子句。当某一行在导入器从未写入的至少一列中有值时，该行属于测量阶段——"never wrote" 依据 :func:`importer_written_columns` 判定，因此来源信息已被替换掉的数据库仍能得到保护性的答案。

records.context: **Count diff** Objects, microplate sample positions and microscope fields of view, per laboratory microplate and overall. A drop in object count, such as 12% fewer cells, shows that a change affected the run before any p-value is examined.
records.label: spacr.run_compare#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Count diff** Objects, wells and fields, per plate and overall. A drop in object count, such as 12% fewer cells, shows that a change affected the run before any p-value is examined.
records.translation: **计数差异** 对象、孔和视野，按板以及总体统计。对象计数的下降，例如细胞减少 12%，在查看任何 p 值之前就能表明某项更改影响了这次运行。

records.context: **Hit-list diff** For runs that produced regression results: which hits appeared, which vanished, and which only moved. Rank churn among a stable hit set is reported alongside membership, because a top ten that reorders between runs indicates an unstable result even when membership is unchanged.
records.label: spacr.run_compare#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Hit-list diff** For runs that produced regression results: which hits appeared, which vanished, and which only moved. Rank churn among a stable hit set is reported alongside membership, because a top ten that reorders between runs indicates an unstable result even when membership is unchanged.
records.translation: **命中列表差异** 对于产生了回归结果的运行：哪些命中出现了，哪些消失了，哪些只是位置发生了变化。在命中集合保持稳定的情况下，排名变动会与成员变化一起报告，因为在两次运行之间重新排序的前十名，即使成员不变，也表明结果不稳定。

records.context: Not every pair of runs *can* be compared. Different plates, a module one processing session never ran, a different spaCR version: :func:`comparability` says so in words, and :func:`compare_runs` refuses to produce the three tables rather than presenting a misleading one. A version difference is deliberately a warning and not a blocker — it does not stop the comparison, but it has to be on application view, because a Cellpose upgrade between two processing sessions can account for a count change on its own.
records.label: spacr.run_compare#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Not every pair of runs *can* be compared. Different plates, a module one run never ran, a different spaCR version: :func:`comparability` says so in words, and :func:`compare_runs` refuses to produce the three tables rather than presenting a misleading one. A version difference is deliberately a warning and not a blocker — it does not stop the comparison, but it has to be on screen, because a Cellpose upgrade between two runs can account for a count change on its own.
records.translation: 并非每一对运行都*能够*比较。不同的板、一次运行从未运行过的模块、不同的 spaCR 版本：:func:`comparability` 会用文字说明这些情况，而 :func:`compare_runs` 会拒绝生成这三张表，而不是给出一张误导性的表。版本差异有意被设为警告而不是阻断项——它不会阻止比较，但必须显示在界面上，因为两次运行之间的 Cellpose 升级本身就可能导致计数变化。

records.context: The rank is defined here, once, so both sides of a diff are ranked the same way: rows are sorted by **descending absolute score**, ties broken by structured-data name. records.source: The rank is defined here, once, so both sides of a diff are ranked the same way: rows are sorted by **descending absolute score**, ties broken by key. Absolute, because a screen's strongest hit is its largest effect in either direction and ranking a strong protective hit below a weak sensitising one would report rank churn that is an artefact of the sort. When no score column can be found the file's own row order is kept and :attr:`HitList.score_column` is empty, so a caller can tell a real ranking from a preserved one.
records.translation: 排名在这里统一定义一次，使差异的两侧以相同的方式排名：各行按**绝对分数降序**排序，平局按键决定。之所以取绝对值，是因为筛选中最强的命中是其在任一方向上效应最大的命中，而把一个强保护性命中排在一个弱致敏命中之下，会报告出一种由排序方式造成的排名变动。当找不到分数列时，会保留文件自身的行顺序，且 :attr:`HitList.score_column` 为空，使调用方能够区分真实排名与保留的顺序。

records.translation: spaCR 在同一张测量表上有四个视图——UMAP、板热图、数据库浏览器和标注网格。本模块保存它们共享的选择和过滤状态，使在 UMAP 中套索选中的聚类可以在板上定位，而在一个视图中设置的过滤可以缩小其他视图的范围。

records.context: Conflating the two is the usual mistake. A filter can be re-applied to a different table (another plate, a re-run) and still mean something; a selection cannot, because it names individual objects.
records.label: spacr.selection#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Conflating the two is the usual mistake. A filter can be re-applied to a different table (another plate, a re-run) and still mean something; a selection cannot, because it names individual objects.
records.translation: 将二者混为一谈是常见的错误。过滤可以重新应用于另一张表（另一块板、一次重新运行）并且仍有意义；选择则不行，因为它指定的是单个对象。

records.context: **A request** (:class:`ObjectRequest`) is neither: it is one act of routing. "Open exactly these twelve objects, because they are the cells this model called infected and the annotator called uninfected." A filter and a selection are *state* that every view reads; a request is an *event* that travels once, from the view that made it to the view that can show it. It carries the reason with it, because a view showing twelve extracted image regions out of ninety thousand has to be able to say why those twelve — otherwise they read as the whole dataset.
records.label: spacr.selection#11
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

It carries the reason with it, because a view showing twelve crops out of ninety thousand has to be able to say why those twelve — otherwise they read as the whole dataset.
records.translation: **请求**（:class:`ObjectRequest`）两者都不是：它是一次路由行为。"Open exactly these twelve objects, because they are the cells this model called infected and the annotator called uninfected." 过滤和选择是每个视图都会读取的*状态*；请求则是一个*事件*，只从发起它的视图传递一次到能够显示它的视图。它携带着原因，因为一个从九万个裁剪图像中显示十二个的视图必须能够说明为什么是这十二个——否则它们会被当作整个数据集。

records.translation: 对象由 :func:`object_keys` 标识——即表结构自身的行键（``plateID``、``rowID``、``columnID``、``fieldID``、``object_label``），以表结构分隔符连接。这是 ``measurements.db`` 中每张表都已一致认可的唯一身份标识，因此来自 UMAP 的键在板视图中指向同一行，中间无需任何查找表。

records.context: **The object type is part of that identity.** Object tables are one type per table, so without the type a nucleus labelled 1 and a pathogen labelled 1 in the same microscope field of view compose to the *identical* structured-data name. A cell's own children are exactly the objects most likely to collide, which is where object linking is most useful — four objects would open as three extracted image regions, and which one you got would depend on the row order of ``png_list`` (:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` keeps the first). The type now goes into the object component of the structured-data name, exactly as :func:`spacr.schema.object_id` writes it

records.source: **The object type is part of that identity.** Object tables are one type per table, so without the type a nucleus labelled 1 and a pathogen labelled 1 in the same field compose to the *identical* key. A cell's own children are exactly the objects most likely to collide, which is where object linking is most useful — four objects would open as three crops, and which one you got would depend on the row order of ``png_list`` (:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` keeps the first). The type now goes into the object component of the key, exactly as :func:`spacr.schema.object_id` writes it
records.translation: **对象类型是该身份标识的一部分。**对象表每张表只有一种类型，因此若没有类型，同一视野中标签为 1 的细胞核和标签为 1 的病原体会组合成*完全相同*的键。一个细胞自身的子对象恰恰最有可能发生冲突，而那里正是对象关联最有用的地方——四个对象会以三个裁剪图像打开，而你得到的是哪一个，取决于 ``png_list`` 的行顺序（:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` 保留第一个）。现在类型会进入键的对象组成部分，与 :func:`spacr.schema.object_id` 的写法完全相同

records.context: Two rules keep the change from breaking anything already written:
records.label: spacr.selection#16
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two rules keep the change from breaking anything already written:
records.translation: 有两条规则确保这一改动不会破坏任何已写入的内容：

records.context: *Untyped keys do not move.* The untyped form is byte for byte what it was, so every key in every stored selection, exported ``.h5ad`` and prediction bundle still composes and parses as it did. There is nothing on disk to migrate.
records.label: spacr.selection#17
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: *Untyped keys do not move.* The untyped form is byte for byte what it was, so every key in every stored selection, exported ``.h5ad`` and prediction bundle still composes and parses as it did. There is nothing on disk to migrate.
records.translation: *无类型的键保持不变。*无类型形式与原来逐字节相同，因此每个已存储选择、导出的 ``.h5ad`` 和预测包中的每个键仍能像以前一样组合和解析。磁盘上没有任何需要迁移的内容。

records.context: *An untyped structured-data name is less specific, not wrong.* ``plate1_r1_c1_f1_7`` means "the object labelled 7 in that microscope field of view", which is exactly what it always meant — so it matches that object whatever its type, rather than silently matching one of them. Symmetrically a typed structured-data name still matches a row that has not said what it is. :meth:`Selection.mask_for` and :meth:`ObjectRequest.select_from` both apply that rule, and it is the whole migration: an old structured-data name is read as the thing it always said, never re-read as something narrower.
records.label: spacr.selection#18
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: *An untyped key is LESS SPECIFIC, not wrong.* ``plate1_r1_c1_f1_7`` means "the object labelled 7 in that field", which is exactly what it always meant — so it matches that object whatever its type, rather than silently matching one of them. Symmetrically a typed key still matches a row that has not said what it is. :meth:`Selection.mask_for` and :meth:`ObjectRequest.select_from` both apply that rule, and it is the whole migration: an old key is read as the thing it always said, never re-read as something narrower.
records.translation: *无类型的键只是不够具体（LESS SPECIFIC），而不是错误的。*``plate1_r1_c1_f1_7`` 表示 "the object labelled 7 in that field"，这正是它一直以来的含义——因此它会匹配该对象，无论其类型如何，而不是悄悄地只匹配其中之一。对称地，带类型的键仍会匹配一个未说明自身类型的行。:meth:`Selection.mask_for` 和 :meth:`ObjectRequest.select_from` 都应用这条规则，而这就是全部的迁移内容：旧的键会被理解为它一直所表达的含义，绝不会被重新解读为更窄的含义。
